'''Drivoks''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Faket]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref> They had mauve-colored skin, no hair, and to all outward appearances, no distinct gender either.<ref name="Siege" /> Drivoks could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], but seemed to have limited grasp of the syntax, often omitting articles from their speech.<ref name="Siege" /> Drivoks had the ability to sense others, and therefore some Drivoks were employed as trackers and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Barev]] employed a Drivok bounty hunter to locate [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]].<ref name="Siege" />This Drivok was able to sense Obi-wan psychically and locate him on a world map. Obi-wan sensed this detection in the Force but was unable to recognize it.
